description: This source file provides mock implementations and wrapper functions for testing interactions with NetworkManager's libnm API. It encapsulates calls to external functions and internal logic, facilitating unit testing by mocking or substituting actual network interactions.

classes.name: LibnmWraps
classes.description: A singleton wrapper class that abstracts calls to NetworkManager's libnm functions, allowing for mocking and testing. It holds an internal implementation pointer and provides static methods to access network functionalities, either via real calls or mocked implementations.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the internal implementation of the LibnmWraps class, allowing injection of mock objects during testing.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of LibnmWraps.
